ASK OR CONTROL YOUR HOME

Type to ADAM

No “Hey Adam” needed. Replies appear here. Choose a speaker for timers, local time/weather, or calls. Calls connect speakers; they do not use your phone’s microphone.

Ask “Which lights are on right now?” then follow up with “Which one is unavailable?” or “Is it back online?”

ROOM TO ROOM

Intercom

Live conversation

Say “Hey Adam, call Office ADAM” using a speaker’s exact name. Enabled destinations connect automatically with a chime. Both people can speak. Call audio is not recorded.

During a call, say “Hey Adam” to hang up, or use End call on either screen. Calls end after 10 minutes or 90 seconds of silence.

Allow incoming drop-in

Disabled by default. Turning this off also ends any current call involving that speaker.

Rooms & units

Choose where your message should play.

Pair a unit already running ADAM

Install the firmware for your exact board first, then configure Wi-Fi on its screen. This pairing button saves the device key and server address; it does not install or update firmware.

Connect USB to the computer running this head-end. If ADAM runs on a Raspberry Pi, connect the unit to that Pi with USB access enabled. A unit plugged into the laptop viewing this page is not accessible through this button.

The unit's saved Wi-Fi network stays in use.

Local speech & paging

Pages expire after five minutes. Wake-word capability is reported by each unit.
